/* BizHourMapper.getDaysList */
SELECT d.STORE_CD, s.STORE_NM , s.OWNER_NM, s.SYS_STAT_FG , d.DAY_FG , d.SEQ , d.START_TIME , d.END_TIME , SUBSTR(d.START_TIME, 1, 2) AS START_HOUR , SUBSTR(d.START_TIME, 3, 2) AS START_MS , SUBSTR(d.END_TIME, 1, 2) AS END_HOUR , SUBSTR(d.END_TIME, 3, 2) AS END_MS
FROM TB_MS_STORE_BIZHOUR_DAYS d , TB_MS_STORE s WHERE d.HQ_OFFICE_CD = #{hqOfficeCd} AND s.STORE_CD = d.STORE_CD
AND d.STORE_CD IN (${storeCdQuery})
ORDER BY d.STORE_CD, d.DAY_FG, d.SEQ

/* BizHourMapper.getDaysStoreList */ SELECT s.STORE_CD, s.STORE_NM, s.OWNER_NM, s.SYS_STAT_FG , g.DAY_FG , d.SEQ , d.START_TIME, d.END_TIME , SUBSTR(d.START_TIME, 1, 2) AS START_HOUR , SUBSTR(d.START_TIME, 3, 2) AS START_MS , SUBSTR(d.END_TIME, 1, 2) AS END_HOUR , SUBSTR(d.END_TIME, 3, 2) AS END_MS FROM TB_MS_STORE s , ( SELECT TO_CHAR(LEVEL) AS DAY_FG FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 7 ) g , TB_MS_STORE_BIZHOUR_DAYS d WHERE s.HQ_OFFICE_CD = #{hqOfficeCd} AND s.STORE_CD = #{storeCd} AND d.HQ_OFFICE_CD(+) = s.HQ_OFFICE_CD AND d.STORE_CD(+) = s.STORE_CD AND d.DAY_FG(+) = g.DAY_FG ORDER BY g.DAY_FG, d.SEQ
mapper.insert: /* BizHourMapper.insertDays */ INSERT INTO TB_MS_STORE_BIZHOUR_DAYS ( HQ_OFFICE_CD, STORE_CD, DAY_FG, SEQ, START_TIME, END_TIME, REG_DT, REG_ID, MOD_DT, MOD_ID ) VALUES ( #{hqOfficeCd}, #{storeCd}, #{dayFg}, #{seq}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{regDt}, #{regId}, #{modDt}, #{modId} )
mapper.select:
/* BizHourMapper.getSpecificList */
SELECT sp.STORE_CD, s.STORE_NM , s.OWNER_NM, s.SYS_STAT_FG , sp.BIZ_DATE , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(sp.BIZ_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'DY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=KOREAN') AS DAY_NM , sp.SEQ , sp.BIZ_FG , sp.START_TIME , sp.END_TIME , sp.REMARK , SUBSTR(sp.START_TIME, 1, 2) AS START_HOUR , SUBSTR(sp.START_TIME, 3, 2) AS START_MS , SUBSTR(sp.END_TIME, 1, 2) AS END_HOUR , SUBSTR(sp.END_TIME, 3, 2) AS END_MS
FROM TB_MS_STORE_BIZHOUR_SPECIFIC sp , TB_MS_STORE s WHERE sp.HQ_OFFICE_CD = #{hqOfficeCd} AND s.STORE_CD = sp.STORE_CD
AND sp.STORE_CD IN (${storeCdQuery})
ORDER BY sp.STORE_CD, sp.BIZ_DATE, sp.SEQ
mapper.insert: /* BizHourMapper.insertSpecific */ INSERT INTO TB_MS_STORE_BIZHOUR_SPECIFIC ( HQ_OFFICE_CD, STORE_CD, BIZ_DATE, SEQ, BIZ_FG, START_TIME, END_TIME, REMARK, REG_DT, REG_ID, MOD_DT, MOD_ID ) VALUES ( #{hqOfficeCd}, #{storeCd}, #{bizDate}, #{seq}, #{bizFg}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{remark}, #{regDt}, #{regId}, #{modDt}, #{modId} )
mapper.update: /* BizHourMapper.saveStoreUseYn */ MERGE INTO TB_MS_STORE_ENVST USING DUAL ON ( STORE_CD = #{storeCd} AND ENVST_CD = '1361' ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ENVST_VAL = #{envstVal}, USE_YN = 'Y', MOD_DT = #{modDt}, MOD_ID = #{modId} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( STORE_CD, ENVST_CD, ENVST_VAL, DIRCT_IN_YN, USE_YN, REG_DT, REG_ID, MOD_DT, MOD_ID ) VALUES ( #{storeCd}, '1361', #{envstVal}, 'N', 'Y', #{regDt}, #{regId}, #{modDt}, #{modId} )
